# No work on weekends

> From 2026-08-18 the studio stops working on weekends.

- [decision] 2026-08-18: Client messages sent on a weekend are answered on Monday.
- [ban] 2026-08-18: No launches on Fridays either, so nothing breaks over a weekend.
